title: Maximum fanin of a list with a new first circuit
statement: For every natural number $n$, every Boolean circuit tree $c$ on $n$ variables, and every finite list $cs$ of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables, the maximum fanin of the list formed by placing $c$ first in $cs$ is the maximum of the fanin of $c$ and the maximum fanin in $cs$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables
$cs$ is a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables
